title:
LIVE
All the latest transfer rumours; Club World Cup action and reaction
content:
Keep up to date with all of Friday's transfer rumours as well as news from the Club World Cup.

Morgan Gibbs-White is still open to joining Manchester City this summer, but it remains to be seen whether they step up their interest having already signed Rayan Cherki from Ligue 1 side Lyon.

Fiorentina are eager to secure an agreement for Empoli midfielder Jacopo Fazzini with talks set to continue this weekend. Read the latest transfer news from Serie A here.

Barcelona have unveiled goalkeeper Joan García.

Sunderland are leading the race to sign Dynamo Kyiv's Vladyslav Vanat.

Some breaking news as Wolves have confirmed their first arrival of the summer window in Spanish midfielder Fer López.

Paris Saint-Germain are closing in on a deal to sign Bournemouth centre back Illia Zabarnyi.

Barcelona are confident a deal for Nico Williams can be agreed as early as next week. Read all about it here.

Milos Kerkez is expected to travel to Liverpool and finalise his move early next week.

Stuttgart have offered striker Nick Woltemade a new contract in a bid to fend off interest from other European clubs. While an agreement is yet to be reached with the player, there is a strong desire from the Bundesliga club to keep the 23-year-old Germany international. Read all about it here.

Manchester United are still the frontrunners to sign Bryan Mbeumo this summer but will need to significantly improve their offer for the player...

Alexander Isak continues to be linked with a move to Liverpool but it would take an astronomical offer for Newcastle to be tempted to the negotiating table...

Liverpool reach agreement with Bournemouth to sign left back Milos Kerkez. The Hungary international is expected to undergo a medical next week.

Juventus have reignited their interest in Manchester United winger Jadon Sancho and have opened preliminary talks with the Premier League club. Read the latest rumours on Sancho's future here.

Ligue 1 side Monaco are considering a move for Manchester United goalkeeper André Onana.

Juventus star Dusan Vlahovic is awaiting offers from top clubs as he looks set to depart the Serie A club this summer. Real all about the forward's future here.

More on Florian Wirtz...

The 22-year-old is said to have completed his medical at Liverpool and the move is now being finalised.

In light of interest from other clubs, Everton have opened contract talks with defender Jarrad Branthwaite.

Roma have made Flamengo right back Wesley their top priority this summer. You can read all about it here.

Some news from the women's game this afternoon as Lyon have signed defender Ingrid Engen on a two-year deal following the expiration of her contract with Barcelona.

In case you missed it, Florian Wirtz is currently in Liverpool finalising his £100m move to Anfield.

The Germany international flew in from Cologne on Thursday evening and medical tests are well underway.

Kingsley Coman has addressed his Bayern Munich future...

Real Madrid are on the hunt for a midfielder this summer but a move for one target has now been ruled out by the La Liga giants. Read all about it here.

Martín Zubimendi is in London ready to complete his move to Arsenal...

In case you missed it, you can recap all of last night's Club World Cup action right here.

We'll kick things off with some rumours from Anfield as Liverpool look set to ramp up their centre back search.

Hello everyone! Welcome to Friday's transfer live blog as we keep you up to date with all the latest rumours and updates, as well as news from the Club World Cup.

Stay tuned!
